text:
amanda_sales: Heads-up 1: TidalPay asked for a 4-week onramp POC to replace VendorX. Main asks: compatibility (prompt/response parity + headers), cost estimate for 1M req/day @128 tokens, SAML SSO + BYOK flow, and full security questionnaire. Kickoff tomorrow 11am PT. Can we list show-and-tell items?

jia_engineer: I'll take parity. Ask they've given us 20 example prompts and a couple of webhook flows. Need canonical outputs from VendorX and any post-processing rules (e.g., trimming, anonymization).

amanda_sales: Sent their example bundle to the shared drive. They also specifically called out streaming differences and stop-token heuristics.

omar_se: Quick notes on behavior differences we've seen migrating other customers: VendorX sometimes applies a final-pass sanitizer that removes <acct_mask> tokens. Redwood doesn't mutate outputs unless a post-filter is configured. We should test raw model outputs and their post-filtered outputs.

priyanka_ml: For measurement plan: run deterministic seed runs (where possible) and sampling sweeps. Metrics: exact-match on required entities, normalized BLEU/ROUGE, and a custom predicate for billing-sensitive fields (e.g., payment_token format). Also measure distribution of token counts to validate billing delta.

eli_sre: Pricing sketch: 1M req/day * 128 tokens = 128M tokens/day. For hosted: token rate * hosted unit price + egress. For Dedicated: we'd size ~4-8 reserved vGPUs for ~150ms p99 depending on concurrency. I'll drop a ballpark table in the sheet before noon.

amanda_sales: They asked about per-tenant invoicing and per-route rate limits. Can we do per-customer metering and separate billing tags?

eli_sre: Yes, we support customer tags and invoice OUs; rate limits can be enforced per API key/route. For the POC we'll grant a scoped API key and enable request-level metering.

secbot: Quick audit summary: SOC2 Type II available; ISO27001 in progress. BYOK flow: support for AWS KMS and customer-supplied HSM via API integration. SAML: Okta and Azure AD tested. Will attach checklist link.

elena_legal: Contract note: they require EU-only residency for PII and 6-month deletion SLA for logs. Also want subprocessors list and ability to audit. We'll prepare a DP addendum and subprocessor list.

vikram_sec: Security addendum: we'll need to walk them through our key rotation & compromise playbook. Also confirm penetration test windows and whether remote pentest is allowed during POC.

omar_se: Practical test harness plan: 1) Reproduce VendorX outputs: we need exact request payloads and any headers (e.g., X-Vendor-Context). 2) Run Redwood hosted with same model family and raw params (temp/top_p/seed). 3) Run Redwood with shim that emulates their postfilter (if necessary) to show parity path. 4) Run 1k randomization tests across prompt variants to show stability.

jia_engineer: Can someone share the exact curl examples VendorX used? We need to reproduce streaming framing differences. Example we saw from them:

```bash
curl -s -N https://api.vendorx.com/v1/chat/stream \\\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VEND_TOKEN" \\\n  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize payment flow"}],"stream":true,"stop":["\\n\\n"]}'
```

I want to run this against both endpoints and capture chunk boundaries.

priyanka_ml: Also include a temperature sweep (0, 0.3, 0.8) and sample seeds where vendor allows it. We'll log perplexity and token-level deltas.

amanda_sales: Timeline for POC: Week 0 (kickoff + infra setup), Week 1 baseline parity + pricing, Week 2 BYOK + SSO setup, Week 3 scale/regression tests, Week 4 cutover rehearsal + exec demo. Ok?

eli_sre: Sounds good. Note provisioning BYOK test-key + staging IP allowlist ~48 hrs. For SAML SSO we'll need a test IdP config from them.

elena_legal: I'll draft a one-page POC SoW covering scope, data residency, SLA 99.5% for POC, and acceptance criteria (entity-level parity >= 95% and < 10% sampling variance on required fields).

amanda_sales: Action items: 1) @jia_engineer - build harness & run baseline by EOD Wed (need VendorX payloads). 2) @eli_sre - provision test KMS key + enable scoped API key + add staging IPs. 3) @vikram_sec - confirm pentest windows and BYOK steps. 4) @elena_legal - draft SoW + DP addendum. 5) @priyanka_ml - provide eval notebooks and scorer configs.

omar_se: One blocker to raise during kickoff: VendorX uses header X-Vendor-Context that influences decoding (experiment flags). If TidalPay depends on that, we either need to accept their header and map it to request.metadata or implement a compatibility shim. Amanda, ask them to disclose any nonstandard headers they relied on.

amanda_sales: Will ask and add to the meeting agenda. Invite sent for 11am PT. Please bring any short demos. :thumbsup:
